inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected README, CONTRIBUTING, templates, top-level folders, and GitHub workflow

anchors.why: Identifies the project as a community-maintained data engineering wiki and lists its main category structure.
Defines note frontmatter, title conventions, templates, separate PR guidance, mermaid guidance, and AI-generated-content policy.
Shows aliases, lifecycle tags, publish false, advantages, disadvantages, resources, recent posts, edit/copy affordances, and helpfulness feedback.
Shows a simple candidate concept shape with advantages and disadvantages.
Runs scheduled/manual link checking and creates a GitHub issue with failures.

known_limits: Lifecycle tags are maturity/routing labels, not truth confidence.
Community contribution process is not evidence-aware review.
Link checking detects availability, not factual support.
